title: Event-only crash camera and corrected Gorn presentation
summary: The host candidate replaces user-reported continuous public driving shake with brief event impulses, keeps both ATV and rider in the severe crash view, removes stretched cross-limb mesh bridges, and lowers crash-path cost.
details: The previously deployed shake reacted to ordinary speed, RPM and suspension chatter. This candidate produces exactly zero shake during normal riding and wheel-only suspension contacts; qualified body hits, genuine airtime followed by downward landings, and limited crash events create short rotational-only pulses of 0.26 seconds or 0.48 seconds for severe impacts.

Camera design references Squirrel Eiserloh, GDC 2016 “Juicing Your Cameras with Math,” slides 10, 16 and 18 (trauma-squared intensity, smoothed noise, rotation-only 3D shake): https://media.gdcvault.com/gdc2016/Presentations/Eiserloh_Squirrel_JuicingYourCameras.pdf. Unity Cinemachine 3.1 describes game-event-triggered impulse sources and reacting listeners: https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.cinemachine@3.1/manual/CinemachineImpulseSourceOverview.html.

A shared crash view fits the ATV and detached rider bounds together. All eight corners of the tested posed bounds fit within a 0.85 NDC margin; portrait/landscape cases and terrain clearance pass, without recursively resetting the view.

The severed-rig mesh now drops triangles that bridge independently moving skeleton components, removing 119 cross-component bridges. The severe inspection reports 42 rider draws, 18,186 triangles, and a largest measured edge of 0.943 ft.

The severe Gorn gate passed 1,496 paired WASM gameplay/camera steps and 104 after reload; it showed three aerial frames with the ATV intact, two damage transitions, seven detached ATV parts, five severed rider nodes, exactly 90 droplets, nonzero shake and boom, and intact recovery.

Crash work was reduced by lowering terrain queries from ten to two per joint/substep, sleeping settled blood, avoiding serialized terrain-query payloads, caching poses and cut indices, prewarming the blood shader, and uploading only changed physics data.

In 20 sequential headless host samples, four-step Gorn WASM batch mean fell from 3.050 ms to 1.955 ms (about 36%); mean render CPU fell from 1.227 ms to 1.092 ms and rolling frame time from 20.456 ms to 13.550 ms. These are host measurements, not FPS or mobile-performance guarantees.

Host gates pass: make verify, make check (367 atv-core plus workspace Rust tests, 130 frontend JavaScript tests, formatting and strict Clippy), 35 release Python tests and 19 Worker tests. Final source head 703f02b passed the severe browser gate; integration merge 43e604e includes the separate weather update and its merged verification was pending at recording time.
limitation: Host-only, captured in Chromium Metal at 1280×844; the public site still serves the previous shake behavior until a validated release. No physical-phone performance or original-game camera/ragdoll parity is established. Enhanced-crash foliage dithering remains limited to the foreground corridor. New CI and public HTTPS verification are pending.

status: Host-verified event-only crash camera and corrected Gorn presentation; the public site still has the earlier shake behavior pending validated release.
working_on: Run merged CI, then verify the public crash camera, shake and Gorn behavior and publish the approved gallery captures.
